subject: Re: Data Analyst interview
body: Hi, I interviewed last Tuesday with Dana and haven't heard anything since. Is there any update on where things stand? Thanks!

subject: Application follow up
body: Good morning. I submitted my application for the Data Analyst position about three weeks ago and wanted to check on its status. Kind regards, Liam

subject: Backend Engineer role
body: Hello, is the Backend Engineer role still open? I applied in March and have not heard back since the confirmation.

subject: Waiting on decision
body: Good afternoon, I was told I would hear a decision within a week of my final interview and it has now been 10 days. Could you tell me where I am in the process?

subject: take-home
body: quick one - did you get my take-home submission? i never got a confirmation so just checking

subject: After final round
body: Hey! Just checking in after the final round last week. Still really excited about the role. Any news?

subject: Under review?
body: I got an automated email saying my application was 'under review' two weeks ago. Is that still the case or has something changed?

subject: update pls
body: any update on my application? thanks

subject: Re: Phone screen invitation
body: Thanks for reaching out! I'm free Thursday or Friday afternoon for the phone screen. What would work on your side?

subject: Interview timing
body: Can we do the interview on a weekend? I work weekdays at my current job and can't easily get time off.

subject: Interview format
body: Is the interview on Zoom or in person? And roughly how long will it run? I want to plan my day.

subject: Time zone
body: I'm based in Lagos (WAT). Could you send interview times that work for that time zone? Thank you.

subject: Panel interview invite
body: Please send the calendar invite for the panel interview. I did not receive anything in my inbox, not even in spam.

subject: Next round
body: Happy to proceed to the next round! How do I go about booking a slot?

subject: Wednesday interview
body: I have a conflict on Wednesday and won't be able to make the interview. Could we move it to sometime next week?

subject: Withdrawing my application
body: I need to withdraw my application as I have accepted another offer. Thank you for your time and consideration.

subject: TODAY 3pm
body: so sorry, family emergency and I can't make the 3pm today. can we rebook please

subject: Please remove me
body: Please remove me from consideration for the role. Thanks for your time.

subject: running late!!
body: Hi, running about 15 min late to the interview, traffic is terrible. Please tell the panel, so sorry

subject: Technical round
body: My availability has changed. I'd need to push the technical round back by about a week if that's possible.

subject: Role details
body: After reading more I see the role is fully onsite, which doesn't work for me. I'd like to withdraw.

subject: Salary range
body: What is the salary range for this role?

subject: Benefits
body: Does the position include health insurance and a pension contribution? Couldn't find it in the job ad.

subject: Expectations
body: I'm currently at $85k. Would you be able to match that or go above it? Want to be upfront before we go further.

subject: Remote and benefits
body: Is the role remote? And what are the working hours and benefits like?

subject: Compensation band
body: Before further steps, could you share the compensation band? I don't want to waste anyone's time.

subject: Signing bonus
body: Is there a signing bonus or relocation package for this position?

subject: Offer letter
body: Thank you for the verbal offer. Could you confirm the offer amount in writing so I can review it?

subject: Portal error
body: The portal gives me an error 500 every time I try to upload my CV. I've tried three browsers.

subject: Wrong resume
body: I accidentally uploaded the wrong resume to my application. Can I replace it?

subject: No confirmation
body: I applied two days ago and never got a confirmation email. Did my application go through?

subject: Profile errors
body: My name is misspelled in my profile (it should be Desai, not Desi) and my phone number is wrong. How do I fix these?

subject: Assessment link
body: The assessment link in your email says it has expired but I never got to open it. Can you send a new one?

subject: Duplicate application
body: I applied twice by mistake for the same role. Could you delete the duplicate?

subject: Cover letter missing
body: My cover letter did not attach when I applied. How can I send it now?

subject: Cancelled again
body: This is the THIRD time my interview has been cancelled at the last minute. That is really unprofessional and I'm losing patience.

subject: Interview experience
body: Your interviewer joined 40 minutes late and was dismissive when I raised it. I expect a response to this.

subject: Promised Friday
body: I was told I would hear back on Friday. It's now Wednesday and nobody has said a word. Candidates' time matters too.

subject: Misleading ad
body: Your job ad said the role was remote but the recruiter told me it's onsite 4 days a week. That is misleading.

subject: Feedback
body: I was rejected after five rounds with no feedback whatsoever. Very disappointed with how this was handled.

subject: Interview question
body: Why was I asked about my marital status and plans for children in my interview? I found that inappropriate and I want this looked at.

subject: Thank you
body: Thank you for the opportunity. It was great meeting the team!

subject: Other roles
body: I wasn't selected for this role but would love to be considered for other openings. Can you keep my CV on file?

subject: Internships
body: Do you offer internships for students? I'm in my final year of a CS degree.

subject: Reference letter
body: Please send me your company's postal address, I'd like to mail a reference letter from my former manager.

subject: Out of Office: Re: Interview
body: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. I will respond when I return.

subject: CV feedback
body: Even though I wasn't successful, could you give me some feedback on my CV?

subject: Re: Interview invite
body: Thanks for the invite. I can do Thursday, but also what's the salary range? And btw the portal won't let me update my CV.

subject: Still waiting
body: Hi, still waiting to hear back and honestly I'm getting frustrated at the silence. Can someone tell me the status?

subject: Offer and start date
body: Thanks for the offer! Can I start in two months instead of one, and is there any flexibility on the base pay?

subject: Hello
body: Hello
